channel.title: RSS Aggregator Feed
channel.description: An aggregated feed of Technology-related news

item.title: Waymo’s cheaper, next-gen robotaxi is now open to all riders in these three cities
item.description: The next-generation robotaxi called the Waymo Ojai, is central to the company's push towards mass scale, and eventually, profitability.

item.title: Alabama town left powerless against massive new Bitcoin mining data center after developer finds loophole in state zoning laws
item.description: An Alabama town and its county both passed moratoriums, but a 50 MW Bitcoin mine is being built anyway because they aren't allowed to zone.

item.title: OpenAI seeks to one-up Anthropic with new customer privacy protections
item.description: A competition is developing between OpenAI and Anthropic over who can provide the best privacy protections for enterprise customer data.

item.title: Flock CEO says drones are 'probably our fastest growing business', but consumer rights groups say they can 'jeopardize privacy' like license plate readers
item.description: Despite a public backlash against the tech, Flock's business is continuing to expand beyond license plate readers.

item.title: Cognition CEO denies report that SpaceX tried to acquire the startup
item.description: SpaceX was reportedly in talks to buy AI coding startup Cognition. SpaceX has already acquired Cursor as it races to catch up to rivals like OpenAI and Anthropic in enterprise AI.

item.title: Travis Kalanick kicks off another round of VC bashing: ‘1% are helpful’
item.description: After raising $1.7 billion for his new robotics company Atoms, Travis Kalanick is introspective about the role VCs have played in his career.

item.title: Japanese ecommerce giant Rakuten teams up with German startup to build military drones
item.description: Rakuten is helping German defence startup Helsing introduce its HX-2 strike drone to Japan's military through ongoing field trials.

item.title: Valve Steam Frame videos show how to wear the headset, perfect the fit and sign in
item.description: Eight leaked Steam Frame videos are informative and kinda silly.

item.title: Waymo Ojai vans are now available for all riders in three cities
item.description: It's a full rollout for the driverless vans in San Francisco, Phoenix and Los Angeles.

item.title: 6 brilliant, budget-friendly headphones for students — including 5-star earbuds, and Sony cans that deliver 'flagship-level features' for an astoundingly low price
item.description: You don't have to spend big for great sound — these tried-and-tested headphones start from just $20.

item.title: Blockbuster is making an unlikely comeback — neighborhood 'Free Blockbuster' boxes are multiplying for DVD and Blu-ray fans, as new website turns Netflix into a 3D video store
item.description: The Blockbuster brand is now dormant, but its aesthetics are back for both physical media and streaming.

item.title: Public TV channel sues Iron Mountain data center after its cloud storage vendor goes out of business, losing over 70 years of archival materials and programming
item.description: A St. Louis PBS station bought cloud storage from a vendor that has now gone defunct and is now in a legal battle with its landlord for access to its own data
